test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Your office junior is afraid to speak up despite having good ideas. How can you encourage them?

options.text: Privately praise their insights and invite them to share, offering support
Take credit for their ideas to boost confidence
Ignore and let them remain quiet
Publicly ask them to speak up in a meeting without prior notice

solution:
Check option: 

**Privately praise their insights and invite them to share, offering support – True, This builds confidence and creates a safe environment for them to express their ideas.**

Take credit
